scope: R2-M4 Gate D real-execution evidence only.
rationale: This environment has no local GPU model and no Human-approved external provider seam. The deterministic seams (REUSE, SCREEN_CAPTURE, DETERMINISTIC via FFmpeg, COMPOSITE via FFmpeg) all carry real evidence. Design section 18.8 requires representative real image/video generation 'where the environment permits'; real provider qualification is deferred to M7 and tracked as R2-OPEN-004 ('resolve post-core').
conditions: M7 must run real GENERATED_IMAGE evidence against a qualified provider before any PRODUCTION_CANDIDATE claim. This waiver does not relax H1 / R2-HOST-001, which stays OPEN.
